_comment: Clek-compatible stroller fragment. Batch S4 (Joolz/M&P/Mima). Sourced 2026-07-05. Do NOT edit seed.json.
name: Joolz Aer+ (covers Aer / Aer+)

clekListed.clekRow: Joolz Aer / Aer+ — Aer/Aer+ Car Seat Adapters

specs._dimsNote: Joolz US spec 83 x 45 x 105 cm open; 53 x 45 x 22 cm folded. IATA cabin-carry compliant.

capacity.minAgeOrNewborn: 6 months to 4 years; from birth only with the separate Aer Nest / carrycot accessory

safety.standards: EN 1888-2 (published by Joolz). Clek's official list attests the model was tested to the applicable ASTM stroller/car-seat standard for Liing use.
safety.notes: 5-point harness; one-hand one-second fold with auto-lock; carry strap. Joolz does not publish a JPMA mark on this model.

specs.foldType: one-hand one-second self-standing compact / airline-cabin fold
specs.recline: multi-position reclining backrest (exact positions not published)
specs.tires: 5.1 in front / 5.9 in EVA-foam wheels; 4-wheel suspension

notes: One of the lightest full-fold city/travel strollers on Clek's list (13.2 lb) — a strong complement to the owned BOB Alterrain Pro. Clek lists 'Aer / Aer+' as one row; the Aer+ is the current 440103 model. Liing attaches via the Joolz Aer car seat adapter (adapter-joolz-aer), which explicitly lists Clek Liing/Liingo on the Amazon/retail listing. Joolz DTC price was $399.20 (20% off, final sale) at check; MSRP $499. ASTM/JPMA not published by Joolz but Clek's list attests ASTM compliance.
